originalTitle: SpaceX at $100 would imply zero AI value, Morgan Stanley says
simplifiedContent: SpaceX's stock price has dropped a lot, and if it falls to $100, it would mean that investors don't think its artificial intelligence business is worth anything. Despite this, analysts at Morgan Stanley think this could be a good time to buy SpaceX stock. Some investors are worried that the stock price will fall even more when some shareholders are allowed to sell their stocks next month. Many investors have lost interest in tech companies that spend a lot on AI, but most analysts still think SpaceX will do well in the future. This means that some people think now might be a good time to invest in SpaceX.

originalTitle: Bond investors, unsure about Fed policy outlook, hedge against US rate shock
simplifiedContent: Here's a rewritten version of the news item in simple language: Bond investors are trying to protect their money because they're not sure what the Federal Reserve, the US central bank, will do next with interest rates. As interest rates keep going up, investors are buying special investments called swaptions that will make them money if borrowing costs increase. This is because they're worried that the Federal Reserve might make big changes to interest rates, which could affect their investments. By buying these swaptions, investors are essentially insuring themselves against potential big increases in interest rates. This shows that investors are getting nervous about what the Federal Reserve might do and are trying to prepare for any surprises.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good day after five days of losses. This happened because tensions between Iran and the US decreased, oil prices went down, and companies reported positive earnings. As a result, the Sensex (a measure of the stock market) went up by 776 points and the Nifty (another measure) reached 23,996. If the Nifty stays above 24,000, analysts think it could go even higher to 24,250-24,300. This is important because it could mean the market is turning positive again after a period of losses.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold and silver edge higher as easing US-Iran tensions cool oil prices
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the prices of gold and silver went up a bit on July 27th. This happened because there's less tension between the US and Iran, which made oil prices go down. As a result, investors started to feel more positive and put their money into gold and silver, making their prices rise - gold went up by $49 and silver by $1.50. This change in investor sentiment is worth paying attention to, especially since the US Federal Reserve is about to meet. The prices of gold and silver are now $4,119 and $60.39, respectively.

originalTitle: AstraZeneca shares climb after earnings beat estimates as cancer drug portfolio drives strong growth
simplifiedContent: AstraZeneca, a big pharmaceutical company, just reported how well it did financially in its latest quarter. The company made more money than experts thought it would, with its earnings per share (a measure of how much money it made) going up 21% to $2.63. This is good news for the company and its investors, and it's mainly because of the strong performance of its cancer drugs. As a result, AstraZeneca's stock price is going up. This matters because it shows that the company is doing well and making more money than expected, which can be a good sign for people who own its stock.

originalTitle: Mold-Tek Packaging Q1 results: Net profit jumps 14% YoY to  ₹25.6 crore; revenue crosses  ₹300 crore
simplifiedContent: Mold-Tek Packaging just released its quarterly financial results, and they're looking good. The company made a net profit of ₹25.6 crore, which is 14% more than it made during the same time last year. Its revenue, or the amount of money it made from sales, also increased by 24.9% to ₹300.45 crore. This is a positive sign for the company, and it's doing well despite some challenging global circumstances. The company's strong performance is due in part to its growth in areas like pharmaceutical packaging, which is helping it recover from previous stock market lows.
